description: Read by the self-hosted Renovate of the cluster this project runs on, once a day. Nothing here merges on its own: every update is a pull request, and CI (ci.yml) says whether it holds. What reaches the till is still decided by a person, since publish-image.yml only ships what main carries once someone dispatches it.

packageRules.description: The pretix base names the published channel (pretix2026.8), which a cluster mirrors and pins by digest (deploy/Dockerfile, publish-image.yml). Its patches already arrive through the rolling minor tag on each rebuild; a new minor is a new channel, so it waits on the dependency dashboard until someone asks for it.
The Python of the images in dev/ follows the one pretix/standalone runs in production, and CI tests that one (ci.yml, backend matrix), not upstream's newest. Patches and digests only.
One pull request for the workflows' actions rather than one per action. Tags are kept, not digests: publish-image.yml explains why it trusts actions/checkout alone.
One pull request for the till's minor and patch updates; each major stays on its own, on the dashboard.
